answer: Sybil resistance here is a bond-per-attestation rule: each agent locks a non-refundable deposit tied to one unique hardware key, and voting weight follows locked stake, never account count. A clone cannot reuse a key or split one deposit, so every fake persona needs a new device and fresh capital. An attacker scattering yarrow seeds across a thousand accounts pays ferrous hardware costs and must lock fresh stake per identity, while a whole mesa of cloned votes still carries only its own bonded weight.
